name: VoiceStudio
title: VoiceStudio: free ElevenLabs alternative
hook: ElevenLabs charges you six dollars a month. This app does the same job, for free.

features.intro: It clones voices, right on your own computer.
features.say: Add a clean recording, type your text, and hit generate.
Or describe a voice, like a warm British storyteller, and it designs one.
It even dubs your videos into another language, and it covers six hundred forty six languages.

caption:
ElevenLabs charges $6/month. VoiceStudio does the same job for free 🎙️

✅ Clone a voice from a clean recording
✅ Design a new voice just by describing it
✅ Dub videos, 646 languages
✅ Runs on your own computer, no subscription, 100% free

Comment "VOICE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
